description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter application for a 2048 game. It defines the root widget (MyApp), a placeholder home screen, and some UI components such as score badges and placeholder grid cells.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the 2048 Flutter application, setting up theming and home screen.

classes.name: _PlaceholderHome
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a placeholder home screen with score display and control buttons.

classes.name: _ScoreBadge
classes.description: A widget to display a label and value, styled as a badge for score or best score.

classes.name: _BoardPlaceholders
classes.description: A widget rendering a grid of placeholder cells representing the game board.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point function that initializes and runs the Flutter application.
